levels.title: Programming Fundamentals (Java)
levels.summary: Before building APIs or connecting databases, master the foundations of programming and the Java platform.
levels.whyItMatters: Every Spring annotation, every JPA query and every thread pool sits on top of these basics. Weak fundamentals are the #1 reason people get stuck later.
levels.projectDescription: A command-line task manager: add/list/complete/delete tasks, save them to a file. Learn loops, file I/O, collections and basic object design without worrying about web layers.

topics.description: Classes, objects, constructors, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction.
